prompt: 哪个单词的意思是「电子的」？
我喜欢能跟着跳舞的音乐。哪一句正确？

choices.text: I like music who I can dance to.
I like music that I can dance to it.
I like music that I can dance to.
I like music which I can dance.

explanation: music 是物，用 that，dance to 的 to 保留。
verify: "I like music that I can dance to."

prompt: 正在说话的那个人是我的老师。哪一句正确？

choices.text: The man which is talking is my teacher.
The man who talking is my teacher.
The man who is talking he is my teacher.
The man who is talking is my teacher.

explanation: 人用 who，从句里不再重复 he。
verify: "The man who is talking is my teacher."

prompt: 这是我昨天买的书。哪一句正确？

choices.text: This is the book which I bought yesterday.
This is the book who I bought yesterday.
This is the book which I bought it yesterday.
This is the book which I buy yesterday.

explanation: 物可用 which，bought 是过去式，不重复 it。
verify: "This is the book which I bought yesterday."
